title: Equatorial lone pair in SF₄
statement:
In SF₄, why is the lone pair equatorial in the standard VSEPR assignment?

[_]{a}

choices: It minimizes 90° interactions with other domains.
Only the equator has room for atomic nuclei.
explanations: Lone-pair repulsion favors the site with fewer close interactions.
Both types can host bonded atoms.

hints: The parent arrangement has five domains.
An equatorial site has two 90° interactions.
An axial site has three 90° interactions.
solution: The parent arrangement has five domains. An equatorial site has two 90° interactions. An axial site has three 90° interactions. Lone-pair repulsion favors the site with fewer close interactions.
